question: What exalted status does the practitioner attain through this vidyā?
premises: The practitioner becomes like a son of Pārvatī
The practitioner is honored by all scriptures
This is the result of receiving the vidyā
inference: The practitioner becomes a son of Pārvatī, honored by all scriptures
plain_english: He becomes a son of Pārvatī, honored by all the scriptures.
